subject: RECORD clause
notes: Screened as a row of the RecordClauseRules table, run from DataBinder.ResolveFiles over every declared file once the data forest is indexed - post-build because the size compared is 13.18.43.4 GR8 b)'s, a summation over occurrence counts, redefinition targets and group usage that is not settled while the file description entry is being read. The negative witnesses the rejection (a 20-byte record under RECORD CONTAINS 10); the positive witnesses the boundary where the rule must NOT fire (RECORD CONTAINS 10 BYTES over a record of exactly 10). Nothing screened this rule before kb/Work PB721.
